verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: The Dolby Theatre has served as the permanent home of the Academy Awards ceremony since 2001.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'permanent home of the Academy Awards since 2002'; R5: 'has hosted the annual ceremony since 2001'; R2: 'opened in 2001'
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict on exact year: R1 specifies since 2002 (first ceremony), while R5 says since 2001.
